name: Namor, Atlantean King
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, create a 1/1 blue Merfolk creature token.
Whenever Namor attacks a player who has more life than you, other creatures you control attacking that player get +2/+0 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Namor attacks a player who has more life than you, other creatures you control attacking that player get +2/+0 until end of turn.

needs.what: a selector key naming the creatures attacking one specific player held in a binding (the `defender` of Namor's own `attacks` event), so "other creatures you control attacking that player" picks only the creatures sent at the player Namor attacked
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attacking_player` takes only the words you/opponent/any/most_life (selectors.ATTACKING_PLAYER_WORDS); `opponent` would also pump creatures attacking a different opponent in a pod, and `attacking` has no notion of whom. The trigger half is expressible: event attacks, source self, recheck false, condition {exists {self_only, attacking_player: opponent}} (a player, not a planeswalker) and life_of {binding: defender} > life_of you. The Merfolk token line is expressible since merfolk_1_1_u was added.
